text.en:
Today you learn to say what is happening right now.
I am waiting.
It means: I wait at this moment.
We are leaving.
It means: we go now.

Use am, is or are, then a word with ing.
I am waiting. She is waiting. We are leaving.
I — am. He, she, it — is. We, you, they — are.
The phone is ringing.
The doors are closing.

You will pick am, is or are, and add ing to the action.
Sometimes a letter goes away: write, writing.
Sometimes a letter is doubled: put, putting.
He is cooking.
She is putting her coat on.
